entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

2. This bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in case crime No.277 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B, 323 I.P.C. and section 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Kamla Nagar, District Agra with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The applicant is father-in-law of deceased.
Earlier, the deceased was married with one Nitesh in the year 2011 but there had been some dispute between them and thereafter, deceased has married with son of applicant on 01.05.2023.

It was submitted that only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the Harvilas vs State Of U.P. on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40572602/
1 accused persons, including applicant.
No specific role has been assigned to the applicant.

It was submitted that though in postmortem report, cause of death of deceased has been shown strangulation and some other injuries were also shown but there is no evidence that applicant was involved in causing injuries to the deceased.
The deceased has suffered injuries in dispute with her husband.
It is further submitted that wife of applicant is suffering from paralysis and there is no-one to look after her.

It has been further submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 11.11.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that deceased has suffered death other than under normal circumstances within a period of seven years of her marriage.

5. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
6. The bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Harvilas involved in aforesaid case be released on bail on furnishing each a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
i.
The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
ii. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate any of the prosecution witness.

iii. 
The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

8. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
9.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 10.4.2024 Neeraj/Anand  Harvilas vs State Of U.P. on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40572602/
